items.heading: Most People Searching This Term
items.text: Most people searching this term are picturing a straight line: learn UX writing, apply, get hired. That is not how the Indian product-hiring market actually works for this role right now.

items.heading: UX Writing Is the Practice
items.text: UX writing is the practice of writing the words that live inside a digital product's interface, button labels, form fields, error messages, empty states, onboarding steps, push notifications, and confirmation screens, so a user can complete a task without confusion or hesitation.
